control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, curve right (40/20); else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10/40); else curve right (40/10).

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, then follow the line again.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 % (dim light in a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dim light: it curves right at 40 % and 20 %
bright light: it goes on to stop at walls and follow the line
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
nothing ahead: it follows the line
black: it curves left at 10 % and 40 %
no black: it curves right at 40 % and 10 %

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
what is in front of the robot in the tunnel
what is ahead in bright light
